title: NC-PLUS-SG-5: Remove social-channels code path stubs and add a probe asserting SG-5 adapters load without the social-channels module
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** the backlog item PLUS-SG-5 was parked needs-code by the in-tick doer
**Done check:** CI grep shows zero imports of social-channels in Workers code; social plugin adapters resolve standalone
**Status:** open

Remove social-channels code path stubs and add a probe asserting SG-5 adapters load without the social-channels module

Triage: Removing imports and editing adapters requires code changes beyond the doer's DB read/write scope. | first step: Open a repo issue/comment for a maintainer to grep and remove social-channels imports in Workers code.

Bridged from the backlog by scripts/needs_code_bridge.py (NEEDS-CODE-BRIDGE-1). The change is code, data or a test that a loop consumes; a document alone does not close it.
